events.title: A Car Explodes. Only Bone Fragments Remain. Solve the Case in the Free Demo
events.summary: Bone to Pick is a forensic mystery visual novel where you solve cases by reading bones. In the free demo, you can play the first case, "The Bombed Car," from start to finish (about 30 minutes). A car driving through the city suddenly explodes. All that's left in the wreckage are fragments of the driver's bones. Examine the bones, talk to people, and confront them with the evidence to find out who died and who is behind it.
